subject: Procurement cadence: MSA timing + evidence handoff
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@aeterna.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procure@aeterna.com
Date: 2027-03-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement cadence: MSA timing + evidence handoff

Hi Soojin / Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intros — wanted to kick off scheduling for the MSA redline review and surface the evidence bundle we'll need for procurement to close our vendor intake. Two quick asks:

1) Can we lock a 30-minute redline call this week or early next week? Our legal folks prefer mornings ET.
2) I'm attaching our current marked-up MSA (Aeterna_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf) and an initial list of evidence items. Can you confirm owners and whether Redwood can provide temporary access to audit logs and a SOC2 report?

Proposed windows (ET):
- Thu 3/25 between 10:00–12:00
- Fri 3/26 11:00–13:00

If those don't work we can move to the following week; we'd like to get procurement's checklist into their queue by Friday.

Attachment: Aeterna_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Procurement Lead | Aeterna Health
alex.ramos@aeterna.com
procure@aeterna.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-23T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement cadence: MSA timing + evidence handoff

Alex — thanks for the clear options. We can do Fri 3/26 at 11:00 ET. I'll send the calendar invite once Kimberly confirms availability.

Quick notes / proposed agenda for the call (30 min):
- 0:00–5:00: Introductions and scope (procurement + legal owners)
- 5:00–20:00: Walkthrough of Aeterna's redline highlights (Alex) + Redwood responses
- 20:00–30:00: Evidence handoff checklist and next steps (who provides what, timelines)

I've attached our onboarding evidence checklist so we can map owners during the call. Kimberly — if you think this needs 45 minutes, flag it and we'll extend.

Attachment: onboarding_evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Perfect — Fri 3/26 11:00 ET works for our team. We'll plan for a 30-minute discussion to start; if legal needs more time we can extend to 45.

A couple prep items:
- Can Redwood provide a short (1–2 slide) summary of your hosting model for the pilot and whether the dedicated option is covered in the MSA?
- We'll circulate a short list of procurement questions (attached) so you can pre-populate answers where helpful.

Attachment: procurement-questions.docx (docx, 45KB)

I'll send a provisional calendar invite for 3/26 11:00 ET and include a DocuSign link for the non-material terms we can sign ahead of the full redline review (speeds up procurement queueing).

Thanks,
Alex
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Forwarding and confirming — I can join 3/26 at 11:00 ET. Given the redline depth in Aeterna's file I recommend we book 45 minutes to ensure we don't truncate legal discussion.

I'll prepare a short internal memo mapping each redline to our standard positions and flag any SSO/KMS/KPIs items that will need product/infra input.
